items.Sentence: An earth and rip-rap equalization basin owned by the West Bay Sanitary District may be used to reduce force main flows.
The wastewater treatment process consists of preliminary screening with mechanical bar screens
secondary biological treatment with fixed film reactors
secondary biological treatment with fixed film reactors and aeration basins
chlorine disinfection with sodium hypochlorite, and dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.
Coagulant may be added to the dual media filter flow for recycled water production.
A new headworks planned for late 2023. When placed into operation, the influent will go through new bar screens and a new grit removal system
Primary sludge is processed using a gravity thickener and rotating drum thickeners, and secondary sludge is processed using gravity belt thickeners.
The thickened sludge is pumped to the anaerobic digestion process.
Ferric chloride is added to the anaerobic digester feed to reduce hydrogen sulfide in the digester gas.
Biosolids are de-watered using polymer conditioning and rotary fan press units.
The solids are transported to concrete lined air-drying beds.
Biochar system start-up to allow the Discharger to convert over 40 percent of its biosolids into biochar
